tool.name: OGS: createLayeredMeshFromRasters
tool.description: Creates a layered 3D OGS mesh from an existing 2D OGS mesh and a list of raster files representing subsurface layers.
tool.command: #import re : > 'raster_list.txt'; #set $safe_names = [re.sub(r'[^\w\-.@]', '_', str($item.element_identifier)) for $item in $raster_list] #if len($safe_names) != len(set($safe_names)) #set $joined = ', '.join($safe_names) echo 'error: the element identifiers map to the same file name after characters outside [A-Za-z0-9_.@-] are replaced by _: $joined' >&2; exit 1; #end if #for $item in $raster_list #set $safe_name = re.sub(r'[^\w\-.@]', '_', str($item.element_identifier)) ln -sf '$item' '$safe_name'; echo '$safe_name' >> 'raster_list.txt'; #end for ln -sf '$input_mesh_file' 'input_mesh_file.vtu'; createLayeredMeshFromRasters $ascii_output #if str($thickness) --thickness '$thickness' #end if --raster-list 'raster_list.txt' $keep_surface_material_ids --input-mesh-file 'input_mesh_file.vtu' --output-mesh-file output_1.vtu

param.label: ascii output
param.help: Write VTU output in ASCII format.

param.label: thickness
param.help: The minimum thickness of a layer to be integrated at any given location

param.label: raster files
param.help: Raster files, ordered from the top surface downwards.

param.label: keep surface material ids
param.help: if the argument is present the materials defined in the surface mesh are used to set the material information for the subsurface cells

param.label: input mesh file
param.help: Input (.vtu). The file name of the 2D input mesh

tool.help: Creates a layered 3D OGS mesh from an existing 2D OGS mesh and a list of raster files representing subsurface layers. Supported raster formats are ArcGIS ascii rasters (\*.asc), Surfer Grids (\*.grd), or gridded XYZ rasters (\*.xyz). Only input meshes consisting of line and triangle elements are currently supported as mapping of quads might result in invalid mesh elements.
